title: China Is Building Its Way Around Europe’s EV Tariffs
gist: Aaron Glasserman and Jessie Jiexi Lin argue Chinese EVs keep gaining European share despite EU tariffs, and that subsidies alone understate the threat. Beijing's coordinated overseas industrial policy, with SOEs building infrastructure and private firms following, is letting China vertically integrate EV supply chains in places like Morocco and bypass tariffs.
